# Vendored source libraries

## Agency Agents

`agency-agents/` is a complete, unchanged snapshot of the upstream repository [`msitarzewski/agency-agents`](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents), captured from its `main` branch at commit `4e3ac3ca6604c75113f52c695dbddcc7af928b46` (2026-10-19). It contains the full upstream tree, including all 329 Markdown files and the original `LICENSE`.

The Agency Agents source and its role instructions are credited to AgentLand Contributors and remain under the MIT license in `agency-agents/LICENSE`. This repository preserves the source and does not claim authorship of it.

The Pi importer uses a narrower selection when building the runtime role catalog. It imports recognized specialist roles; strategy material, examples, integration guides, and project documentation remain available here as part of the complete source snapshot without being activated as Pi roles. See [the role import guide](../docs/roles.md#complete-agency-agents-source-snapshot) for the interpretation clarification and import behavior.
